originalTitle: Show HN: A working 3D model of an Enigma machine
content: I watched the excellent Veritasium video [1] on the Enigma machine, and watched the full animation by Jared Owen [2], but was still a bit confused on how the inner mechanics of an Enigma machine work. I used Astra to build out the inner components through a combination of reference images, writing out hundreds of extremely detailed prompts, and building my own inspection tools to ensure that every part is sized and positioned in a historically accurate way. It's still a work in progress, but would love any feedback on the experience so far! 1. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JsBZOcqZerk 2. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ybkkiGtJmkM
chineseTitle: 显示 HN：恩尼格玛密码机的工作 3D 模型
chineseContent: 我在 Enigma 机器上观看了精彩的 Veritasium 视频 [1]，并观看了 Jared Owen 的完整动画 [2]，但对 Enigma 机器的内部机制如何工作仍然有点困惑。我使用 Astra 通过参考图像的组合来构建内部组件，写出数百个极其详细的提示，并构建我自己的检查工具，以确保每个零件的尺寸和位置都以历史上准确的方式进行。该工作仍在进行中，但希望收到有关迄今为止体验的任何反馈！ 1. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JsBZOcqZerk 2. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ybkkiGtJmkM
